newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Medtronic.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PaineWebber ups Medtronic.

text.p: -- PaineWebber analyst David Lothson said he upgraded Medtronic Inc to buy from attractive.
-- He said he expects the new generation of pacemakers the company will introduce worldwide over the next six months will be a catalyst for accelerated earnings at Medtronic.
-- New products and therapies from Medtronic could add $750 million in incremental sales by 2001, Lothson said.
-- The analyst said the stock's valuation is attractive.
-- Raised his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate on Medtronic to $2.80 a share from $2.70. Fiscal 1997 view is $2.27.
